questions.stem: Which factor does NOT increase the rate of evaporation?

options.text: Creating a draught (air flow) over the surface
Increasing the pressure above the liquid
Increasing the surface area of the liquid
Increasing the temperature of the liquid

questions.explanation: Increasing the pressure above the liquid actually decreases the rate of evaporation because it makes it harder for particles to escape from the surface. Higher temperature, larger surface area, and air flow over the surface all increase the evaporation rate.
